detail.tone: The gap-down was steeper than Gift Nifty implied, so sellers are in control of the first hour.
watch: Whether financials stabilise after the first hour

src.title: Sunday Guardian — why the market is down

top.title: IRDAI draft caps insurance commissions
top.line: HDFC Life −7% · Bajaj Fin −4% · Axis −3.6% at open
more: Draft caps: credit life 2% (from 28%), health 5% (from 40%), motor OD 5% (from 16%)
Also bans forced bundling of insurance with loans
Hits insurers, NBFCs and distributors that earn on bundled cover

top.title: US 10-yr yield hits 5.11%
top.line: Highest since 2007 · Dow −0.7%, S&P −0.75%, Nasdaq −1.1% overnight
more: 10-yr jumped 15 bp in a day on hawkish Fed talk and hot US data
Higher US yields pull money out of emerging markets
Asia mixed: Nikkei +1.5%, Kospi +0.9%, Hang Seng −0.7%

top.title: Brent ~$102.5 after 4% jump
more: Oil above $100 pressures the rupee and India's import bill
OMCs, paints, aviation and chemicals are most exposed

src.title: Sunday Guardian — why the market is down

top.title: NSE lists at 10:00
top.line: Issue ₹1,785 · grey market ₹40, only ~2.2% pop implied
more: A weak tape could cap the debut

top.title: BDL wins ₹811 cr defence order
top.line: Exide’s Li-ion cell plant goes live · Fidelity buys ₹279 cr of Welspun Living
more: BDL: ₹810.79 cr Defence Ministry contract for SAT-SAAW equipment
Exide: Phase-I of its 6 GWh lithium-ion cell plant in Bengaluru commissioned
Welspun Living: Fidelity bought 1.30 cr shares (₹279 cr); promoter trust sold 2.45 cr (₹526 cr)
Max Estates: 9.76-acre Ghaziabad JDA, GDV ₹2,500–3,000 cr · Avantel: ₹177 cr Zetwerk order

summary: A heavy, broad-based open: the Nifty gapped down almost 1% and midcaps fell faster, with financial stocks doing most of the damage.
